samples.xml_description:
<module id="LIFObuffer">
    <description>A Last-In-First-Out (LIFO) buffer for temporary data storage. This 4-bit wide buffer can hold up to 4 entries, allowing for push and pop operations controlled by read/write (RW) signals.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="dataIn" width_description="[3:0]">Data to be pushed onto the buffer.</input>
        <input id="RW">Read/Write control signal (1 for read, 0 for write).</input>
        <input id="EN">Enable signal to activate buffer operations.</input>
        <input id="Rst">Active high reset signal to initialize the buffer.</input>
        <input id="Clk">Clock signal for synchronous operations.</input>
        <output id="EMPTY">Flag indicating whether the buffer is empty.</output>
        <output id="FULL">Flag indicating whether the buffer is full.</output>
        <output id="dataOut" width_description="[3:0]">Data retrieved from the buffer.</output>
    </ports>
    <implementation>The buffer uses a stack memory array (stack_mem) to store the data. A stack pointer (SP) tracks the current position in the stack.</implementation>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <register id="SP" width_description="[3:0]">Stack Pointer to track the top element of the stack.</register>
        <register id="dataOut" width_description="[3:0]">Data Output register to store data to be popped from the stack.</register>
        <reg id="EMPTY">Empty flag to indicate if the stack is empty.</reg>
        <reg id="FULL">Full flag to indicate if the stack is full.</reg>
        <memory id="stack_mem" size="4" depth="4" width_description="[3:0]">Stack Memory Array to store the elements of the stack.</memory>
    </logic_description>
    <task id="initialize_buffer">
        <description>This task initializes the buffer during reset.</description>
        <block>
            SP <= 4;
            EMPTY <= 1;
            FULL <= 0;
            dataOut <= 0;
            foreach(stack_mem[i]) begin
                stack_mem[i] = 0;
            end
        </block>
    </task>
    <always @(posedge Clk) begin
        if(EN == 1'b1) begin
            if(Rst == 1'b1) begin
                initialize_buffer();
            end else begin
                if(FULL == 1'b0 && RW == 1'b0) begin
                    SP <= SP - 1;
                    stack_mem[SP] <= dataIn;
                    EMPTY <= 0;
                    if(SP == 3'd1) begin
                        FULL <= 1;
                    end
                end else if(EMPTY == 1'b0 && RW == 1'b1) begin
                    dataOut <= stack_mem[SP];
                    stack_mem[SP] <= 0;
                    SP <= SP + 1;
                    FULL <= 0;
                    if(SP == 3'd3) begin
                        EMPTY <= 1;
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end</module>
